jub.definition: n. A vessel for holding ale or wine; a jug.

juba.definition:
n. The mane of an animal.
n. A loose panicle, the axis of which falls to pieces, as in
   certain grasses.
juba.translation: n. 朱巴舞(美国南部农场黑人的一种舞蹈)

jubal.translation: n. 犹八（基督教《圣经》故事人物, 创制乐器的始祖）

jubate.definition: a. Fringed with long, pendent hair.
jubate.translation: a. 有马鬃般长毛的; 具缘垂毛

jubayl.translation: [地名] [埃及、黎巴嫩] 朱拜勒

jubbah.translation: n. <阿> 穆斯林男女所穿的宽敞衣物

jubbulpore.definition: n an industrial city of central India to the southeast of Delhi
jubbulpore.translation: 贾巴尔普尔[印度中部城市](或译赞浦尔)

jube.definition:
n. chancel screen or rood screen.
n. gallery above such a screen, from which certain parts of the
   service were formerly read.
jube.translation: n. (教堂中十字架屏饰上部的)祭廊

juberous.translation: a. 怀疑的, 犹豫的

jubilance.definition: n a feeling of extreme joy

jubilant.definition:
s joyful and proud especially because of triumph or success
s full of high-spirited delight
jubilant.translation: a. 欢呼的, 喜洋洋的

jubilantly.translation: adv. 欢欣地, 喜气洋洋地

jubilate.translation:
vi. 欢呼, 欢喜
n. 欢呼

jubilated.definition:
v celebrate a jubilee
v to express great joy
jubilated.translation: v. 欢呼( jubilate的过去式和过去分词 )

jubilates.definition:
v celebrate a jubilee
v to express great joy
jubilates.translation: v. 欢呼（jubilate的第三人称单数形式）

jubilating.definition:
v celebrate a jubilee
v to express great joy
jubilating.translation: v. 欢呼( jubilate的现在分词 )

jubilation.definition:
n a feeling of extreme joy
n a joyful occasion for special festivities to mark some happy event
n the utterance of sounds expressing great joy
jubilation.translation: n. 欢呼, 喜欢, 庆祝

jubilations.definition:
plural of jubilation
n a feeling of extreme joy
n a joyful occasion for special festivities to mark some happy event
n the utterance of sounds expressing great joy
jubilations.translation: (jubilation 的复数) n. 欢呼, 喜欢, 庆祝

jubilee.definition: n. a special anniversary (or the celebration of it)
jubilee.translation: n. 五十周年纪念/庆祝, 二十五周年纪念/庆祝, 欢乐的佳节, 欢庆日, 狂欢节

jubilees.definition: n. a special anniversary (or the celebration of it)
jubilees.translation: n. 周年纪念( jubilee的复数形式 )
